raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The Muse Spark Open cookbook page has launch commands for single deployments but none tuned along the latency/throughput curve for agentic serving on GB300. This PR adds five Dynamo + SGLang deployments on GB300, measured with the [Artificial Analysis AgentPerf](https://github.com/ArtificialAnalysis/agentperf-client) coding-agent workload. Together they cover the curve from the lowest per-user latency (concurrency 1) to the highest throughput per GPU (concurrency 160). Of the 43 points on the measured SGLang Pareto frontier, these five keep both ends and cover 81% of its area.

## Source

All five start from the Artificial Analysis SGLang submission for this model (`lmsysorg/sglang:dev-muse-spark-open@sha256:8cfc5a72…`, TP4·EP4, DFlash2 with 8 draft tokens, FP8 KV cache). They add the Dynamo frontend (KV-aware router with session affinity) and change only flags, environment variables and parallelism. There are no source or image changes beyond the Dynamo wheels (`ai-dynamo` / `ai-dynamo-runtime` `1.6.0.dev20261019` from PyPI).

Changes from that submission:

- **Agg TP8·EP8 (2 nodes), lowest latency:** TP8·EP8 over 2 nodes, layernorm SP and MegaMoE-for-SP off, `NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=1`, `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True`.
- **Agg TP8·EP8 (2 nodes), low latency:** same as c1.
- **Agg TP4·EP4, balanced:** `--prefill-decode-interval 64`.
- **Agg TP4·EP4, high throughput:** `--prefill-decode-interval 24`, `--max-running-requests 64`, `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64`, `--swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.15`, `SGLANG_OPT_UNIFIED_CACHE_FREE_OUT_OF_WINDOW_SLOTS=1`.
- **Agg TP4·EP4 + HiCache, max throughput:** HiCache (`--hicache-size 120`), `--prefill-decode-interval 6`, `--max-running-requests 176`, `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 176`, `--mem-fraction-static 0.9`, `--swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.15`, `SGLANG_OPT_UNIFIED_CACHE_FREE_OUT_OF_WINDOW_SLOTS=1`.

## Measured results

GB300 (4 GPUs per tray), Artificial Analysis AgentPerf coding-agent scenario, full-length runs. Throughput per GPU counts input and output tokens, as AgentPerf reports it.

| Deployment | GPUs | Concurrency | p25 output tok/s/user | Total tok/s/GPU | Output tok/s/GPU | TTFT p95 (s) | Prefix-cache hit | Requests |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Agg TP8·EP8 (2 nodes), lowest latency | 8 | 1 | 485.8 | 2,514 | 20 | 0.10 | 97.5% | 1228/1228 |
| Agg TP8·EP8 (2 nodes), low latency | 8 | 4 | 387.7 | 11,222 | 81 | 0.17 | 97.6% | 1945/1945 |
| Agg TP4·EP4, balanced | 4 | 16 | 208.7 | 49,646 | 341 | 1.50 | 97.0% | 4628/4628 |
| Agg TP4·EP4, high throughput | 4 | 64 | 97.1 | 114,342 | 783 | 3.26 | 96.9% | 12165/12165 |
| Agg TP4·EP4 + HiCache, max throughput | 4 | 160 | 40.9 | 185,382 | 1,237 | 2.61 | 96.8% | 41112/41143 |

Every run passed the validity checks used for these points: at least 94% of turns end in a tool call (95.6–97.5% here), and no reply runs away to the 16k-token limit.

## What this PR does

Adds a subsection, **GB300 deployments measured with Artificial Analysis AgentPerf**, to the Agentic Long-Context Deployment section of `docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Meta/MuseSparkOpen.mdx`. It holds one collapsible entry per deployment, ordered from low latency to high throughput. Each entry has tabs in launch order: Env Vars (placeholders), etcd, the Dynamo frontend, then the SGLang worker. A two-node worker uses one command with `$NODE_RANK`. The page has no performance numbers, and nothing else on the page changes.

## How the commands are produced

- **Workers:** the exact `dynamo.sglang` command and environment each run launched, taken from its launcher log. For the two-node deployments, both nodes' commands normalize to the same text.
- **Frontend and etcd:** rebuilt from the run's recipe with the same launcher (`dynamo.frontend` gets the recipe's router arguments and environment as given).
- **Cleanup:** the same keep / remove / rewrite rules as the earlier cookbook syncs (#42726, #43083). Removed: cluster paths, the benchmark client, telemetry and log switches, and per-run ports. Rewritten: weights and draft to Hugging Face ids, IPs to placeholders, ports to the cookbook defaults. Anything those rules do not classify is listed explicitly: `--dyn-reasoning-parser`, `--dyn-tool-call-parser`, `DYN_TOKENIZER*` and `DYN_ROUTER_QUEUE_THRESHOLD` are kept, and `HF_HUB_OFFLINE` is removed.

## Validation

- `mint validate` (strict build) and `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` pass with the CI-pinned mint (4.2.559). `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` passes. `pre-commit run` on the changed file passes.
- Every worker command launched as shown, apart from the placeholder rewrites, in the measured runs on that image.

- Tab groups are independent: each deployment's `<Tabs>` sets `sync={false}`, since Mintlify otherwise syncs same-title tabs across the page. Checked in headless Chromium under `mint dev`: clicking etcd in one deployment changes only that deployment's tab; without the prop all five switched.

SGLang CI was not triggered.

@@ -48,6 +48,401 @@ import { agentx } from "/src/snippets/agentx/meta-models/muse-spark-open.jsx";
 
 <AgentX data={agentx} />
 
+### GB300 deployments measured with Artificial Analysis AgentPerf
+
+Five aggregated Dynamo + SGLang deployments on GB300, measured with the [Artificial Analysis AgentPerf](https://github.com/ArtificialAnalysis/agentperf-client) coding-agent workload. Together they span the trade-off from the lowest per-user latency (concurrency 1) to the highest throughput per GPU (concurrency 160), ordered from low latency to high throughput. Each one starts from the Artificial Analysis SGLang submission for this model and changes only flags, environment variables and parallelism.
+
+- **Container image.** `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-muse-spark-open@sha256:8cfc5a72cb296771f5f8a4a4688cb6d05685610a830cbb616fa4ab0eb7bb2b0a` with the Dynamo wheels added: `pip install --no-deps ai-dynamo==1.6.0.dev20261019 ai-dynamo-runtime==1.6.0.dev20261019`.
+- **Router.** One Dynamo frontend with the KV-aware router. Session affinity keeps requests that carry the same `X-Dynamo-Session-ID` header on one worker; the AgentPerf client sends one ID per agent session.
+- **Checkpoints.** `meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4` with the DFlash2 draft `RadixArk/Muse-Spark-Open-DFlash2` (8 draft tokens, FP8 KV cache).
+- **HiCache.** `--hicache-size` is the host tier in GB per rank; scale it to your host memory.
+- **Two-node deployments.** The TP8·EP8 worker spans two GB300 trays (4 GPUs each) over multi-node NVLink: run the worker command on both nodes, with `NODE_RANK` 0 on the first.
+
+<AccordionGroup>
+  <Accordion title="Agg TP8·EP8 (2 nodes), lowest latency · 8 GPUs · concurrency 1">
+  <Tabs sync={false}>
+    <Tab title="Env Vars">
+```bash
+export ETCD_IP=<node running etcd>
+export AGG_HEAD_IP=<first node of the worker>
+export NODE_RANK=<0 on the first node, 1 on the second>
+```
+    </Tab>
+    <Tab title="etcd">
+```bash
+etcd \
+  --data-dir /tmp/etcd \
+  --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 \
+  --advertise-client-urls http://$ETCD_IP:2379
+```
+    </Tab>
+    <Tab title="Dynamo frontend">
+```bash
+export DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp
+export DYN_ROUTER_QUEUE_THRESHOLD=None
+export DYN_ROUTER_TEMPERATURE=0
+export DYN_TOKENIZER=fastokens
+export DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE=1
+export DYN_TOKENIZER_CACHE_BYTES=8000000000
+export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://$ETCD_IP:2379
+
+python3 -m dynamo.frontend \
+  --http-port 8000 \
+  --router-mode kv \
+  --router-session-affinity-ttl-secs 14400 \
+  --active-decode-blocks-threshold None \
+  --active-prefill-tokens-threshold None \
+  --active-prefill-tokens-threshold-frac None
+```
+    </Tab>
+    <Tab title="SGLang worker (run on each of the 2 nodes)">
+```bash
+export DYN_REQUEST_PLANE=tcp
+export ETCD_ENDPOINTS=http://$ETCD_IP:2379
+export NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1
+export NCCL_MNNVL_ENABLE=1
+export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
+export SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=900
+
+python3 -m dynamo.sglang \
+  --model-path meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 \
+  --served-model-name meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 30000 \
+  --dist-init-addr $AGG_HEAD_IP:20000 \
+  --nnodes 2 \
+  --node-rank $NODE_RANK \
+  --kv-events-config '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","endpoint":"tcp://*:5557"}' \
+  --request-plane tcp \
+  --dyn-reasoning-parser muse \
+  --dyn-tool-call-parser muse \
+  --expert-parallel-size 8 \
+  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
+  --max-running-requests 32 \
+  --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
+  --mm-feature-transport cpu \
+  --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_trtllm \
+  --quantization modelopt_fp4 \
+  --reasoning-parser muse \
+  --speculative-algorithm DFLASH \
+  --speculative-draft-attention-backend fa4 \
+  --speculative-draft-model-path RadixArk/Muse-Spark-Open-DFlash2 \
+  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 8 \
+  --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 \
+  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
+  --trust-remote-code \
+  --watchdog-timeout 3600
+```
